lines.zh: 我在叶上轻轻晃了一下。
lines.en: I sway slightly on the leaf.

lines.zh: 蛹壳挂在叶背，风一吹就动。
lines.en: The case hangs under the leaf and stirs in the wind.
I can't walk. I can only wait.

lines.zh: 壳里的身体在慢慢变形。
lines.en: Inside the shell, my body is changing.
The vein ridges above me.
I sway with the leaf.
The wings inside aren't open yet.
I hear the wind outside.
A faint sheen lies on the shell.

lines.zh: 我在里面轻轻动了一下。
lines.en: I stir once inside.
The leaf holds me steady.
I'm counting how many days of light are left.
Sunlight comes through, green.
My shell has hardened a little.
I rock with the leaf's rhythm.
The days inside the shell run thick and slow.
The silk holds me under the leaf, steady.

lines.zh: 壳里只有我自己的心跳。
lines.en: Inside the shell there's only my own pulse.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到自己的形状在变。
lines.en: I can feel my shape changing.

lines.zh: 叶子不晃了，我松了口气。
lines.en: The leaf stops swinging and I let out a breath.
I listen to the jungle.
A bug crawls over the leaf.
The shell is warm to the touch.
Not yet time.
I curl a little tighter.
The light under the leaf is faint.
I wait quietly.
The world outside still feels far.
You part the leaf and see me.
I hang here, unable to move.
Your breath makes me sway.
A pupa has nothing to give you.
Your hand reaches, then stops.
The shell is thin. Don't touch.
My wings move inside.
You look for a long time.
The leaf is only so big; there's nowhere to hide.
Your bootsteps are fading into the distance.
A crack opens in the shell.
Half the silk is snapped; I hang by a thread.
My body draws tight inside.
I hold myself with the silk.
The leaf makes a sound.
The shell cracks and I make no sound.
The crack is spreading.
I'm barely holding on.
Just a little longer.
The shell hasn't broken.
I don't even have a mouth anymore.
That's no use to me.

lines.zh: 除了等，我什么也做不了。
lines.en: Beyond waiting, there's nothing I can do.
You hold the leaf closer.
I feel the leaf move.

lines.zh: 啃叶子的那段已经过去。
lines.en: The leaf-chewing part of me is over.
When the wings are grown, we'll talk of food.
Give me a few days and I'll give you wings.
I'll take the thought.
Don't shake this leaf.
The leaf rocks from the blow.
I swing out and the silk pulls me back.

lines.zh: 壳上被撞出一小块凹痕。
lines.en: A small dent is knocked into the shell.
The silk thread still holds.
I fight to steady myself.
This shaking came too early.
Don't knock me loose at this moment.
One more touch and the silk will snap.
The leaf slowly stills.
When the shaking ends, I go back to waiting.
A chrysalis doesn't do that.
Wait until I emerge.
Then I'll look for my kind.
For now there's only me in here.
I'm changing.
My wings aren't formed.
I curl myself properly.
Quiet.

lines.zh: 这一阵风把叶子吹得乱响。
lines.en: This gust sets the whole leaf rattling.
I rock with it.

lines.zh: 这层壳替我隔开了一切。
lines.en: This shell shuts everything away from me.
My legs are no longer of use.
The leaf is all I have.
I shift inside the shell.

lines.zh: 有什么东西在叶下走动。
lines.en: Something is moving beneath the leaf.
I can't see.
I can only listen.
Time passes.

lines.zh: 外面的事，等我出去再说。
lines.en: Whatever's out there can wait until I'm out.
A little longer and it's done.

lines.zh: 有影子从叶缝里压下来。
lines.en: A shadow bears down through the leaf gap.
Something has bent the leaf stem.
My legs have already melted into the shell.
I can only hope it doesn't see me.
My shell matches the leaf.
I don't breathe.
It has stopped beneath the leaf.
Then it moves on.

lines.zh: 它没找到我，我还在叶下。
lines.en: It hasn't found me; I'm still under the leaf.
Keep waiting.
It's right under the leaf and hasn't left.
I don't even let the shell sway.
A green film covers the shell.
It doesn't look up.
I won't move until it turns away.
The wind covers me.
Everything's still quiet.
I slowly relax.
It's almost time.
Just outlast this gust.
I swing and knock against the midrib.
The shell knocks the leaf.
I have no way to strike back.
Blow after blow, I count them.
The shell will protect me.
That much force is nothing.
It's stifling in here.

lines.zh: 我听见叶脉断裂的声音。
lines.en: I hear a vein snap.
The leaf took that blow for me.
So am I.
I've formed a shell on the leaf's underside.
Outside light comes through.

lines.zh: 我的身体在里头化成浆。
lines.en: My body is turning to fluid inside.
Then it will grow anew.
The leaf sways in the wind.
I move with it.
The jungle is loud.

lines.zh: 外面的每一声我都听着。
lines.en: I hear every sound out there.
I'm not yet formed.
Wait.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我听见叶子在烧。
lines.en: The shell bakes; I hear the leaf burning.
I fall and the shell hits the ground.

lines.zh: 水渗进来，里面越来越闷。
lines.en: Water seeps in and it grows stifling.

lines.zh: 气浪把我和叶子一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me with the leaf.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在叶上，壳被震裂。
lines.en: An arrow pins the leaf and the shell cracks.

lines.zh: 光穿进壳里，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Light pierces the shell and numbs me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我能耗尽。
lines.en: I don't eat, but I can run out.
Thunder is close enough to shake the shell.
Leaf and shell fall together.
